headline: Exploring Newtown, Connecticut This Fall
subhead: Historic Main Street, scenic lakes, vibrant trails, and convenient highway access in Fairfield County.
caption: October brings crisp air and brilliant foliage across Newtown. Anchored by the iconic flagpole on Main Street and historic Edmond Town Hall, the town offers classic New England scenery paired with expansive natural spaces. Outdoor recreation is abundant, from quiet hiking trails at Holcombe Hill Wildlife Preserve and Paugussett State Forest to water access along Lake Zoar and Lake Lillinonah. Sandy Hook Village provides walkable dining and local shops right along the Pootatuck River, while nearby farms highlight the autumn season with fresh harvests. Interstate 84 runs right through town, offering straightforward highway connections toward Danbury, Hartford, and downstate travel corridors. If you are exploring communities across Fairfield County, reach out today to learn more about the Newtown real estate market.
